name: blender
title: Blender
summary: Drives the Blender that is open right now. The server lives inside Blender, so Blender has to be running with its MCP add-on on.

app.name: Blender
app.enable: In Blender, turn on the MCP add-on: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons, find the MCP add-on, tick it, and start its server. It listens on 127.0.0.1:8765.

howToUse: Open Blender first. Then call blender_get_addon_info as the handshake before any other blender_* tool.
